name: Boolean Assignment Connectivity Reformulation
description: Rephrases the requirement "all key nodes must be in the same connected component" as a universal condition over all possible binary state assignments to the nodes: any assignment that splits the key nodes into both states must have a selected edge crossing the states. This mathematically forces connectivity while looking like a 2-SAT or Boolean optimization problem, completely hiding the tree-pruning nature of the task from pattern-matching models.
